title: Abba Yose the Hauranite

paragraphs: In Yalkut, Pinchas, section 776, they say in his name: “[Moses] could see all the lands,” etc.
At the end of Tosefta Mikvaot chapter 3 we find Abba Yosef the Hauranite answering Rabbi Yishmael.

notes.text: The consulted Yalkut paragraph makes Moses the one viewing the lands. His name is supplied in brackets for the abbreviated quotation; it is not a claim that Abba Yose himself saw all the lands. Yose in the heading and Yosef in the Tosefta citation are preserved.
The consulted Tosefta Mikvaot has Yosef answering Yishmael, followed by Rabbi’s response to Yosef. The heading and the Yalkut have Yose.
